parameters.name: AliasName
parameters.description: The alias of the vulnerability to query.

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the container cluster.

parameters.name: ClusterName
parameters.description: The name of the cluster.

parameters.name: ContainerId
parameters.description: The ID of the container.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return in a paginated query. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page.

parameters.name: Dealed
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the vulnerability has been handled. Valid values:
- **y**: handled
- **n**: not handled.

parameters.name: Digest
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the container image.

parameters.name: Image
parameters.description: The name of the container image.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the asset instance.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type of the request and response messages. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the vulnerability to query.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The namespace.

parameters.name: Necessity
parameters.description:
The priority level of vulnerability fixing. Valid values:
- **asap**: high-priority vulnerability
- **later**: medium-priority vulnerability
- **nntf**: low-priority vulnerability.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Settings for the number of vulnerabilities to display on each page in a paged query. Default value: **10**, which indicates that 10 vulnerabilities are displayed on each page.

parameters.name: Pod
parameters.description: The pod.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: RepoId
parameters.description: The ID of the container image repository.

parameters.name: RepoInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the container image repository.

parameters.name: RepoName
parameters.description: The name of the container image repository.

parameters.name: RepoNamespace
parameters.description: The namespace of the container image repository.

parameters.name: RepoRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the container image repository.

parameters.name: RuleTag
parameters.description:
The vulnerability tag. Valid values:

- **AI**: vulnerability related to AI components.

parameters.name: ScanRange
parameters.description: The collection of scan ranges.

parameters.name: StatusList
parameters.description:
The fix status of the vulnerability. Valid values:
- **1**: unfixed
- **4**: being fixed
- **7**: fixed.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tag of the container image.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of vulnerability to query. Set the value to **cve**, which indicates container image vulnerabilities.

parameters.name: Uuids
parameters.description: The UUIDs of asset instances. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).
